[7:03AM]  #LagIbdExpWay
#3MB
#TrafficUpdate

Traffic is good coming Inward Berger from Kara bridge down to Emergency centre.
It's a bit slow approaching Tollgate due to  vehicular turning.
Tollgate down to Iyana Oworo is better.

Connecting the Third mainland bridge upto Adekunle is a rapid movement, but a bit slower from the Merging point towards Adeniji.

The return journey on the Third mainland bridge back to Iyana Oworo, Tollgate and Berger looks good.
Drive cautiously!
#FollowLASTMA
@Sola_Giwa 
@lagostraffic961 
@TrafficChiefNG
